name: tgstore
description: Unlimited cloud drive powered by Telegram

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: npm run dev:server & npm run dev:client
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.android:init: npm run build && npx --prefix client cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx --prefix client cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run build && npx --prefix client cap sync android && npx --prefix client cap build android
